description: Required Odoo and Playwright E2E checks that must be invoked through deploy/check_isolated.py with explicit worktree, scratch database, and non-default ports/URLs. Do not substitute environment variables. Do not fall back to odoo.conf db_name, port 8069, or http://localhost:3000.

instructions: Copy or merge the checks array into the quality/flow checks list for this worktree only after replacing every REPLACE_WITH_* token with a concrete absolute path, scratch database name, port, and URL.
Leave required=true. Do not wrap the argv in a shell, and do not prepend env VAR=value.
Do not add E2E_BASE_URL, NUXT_ODOO_URL, NUXT_ODOO_DB, or NUXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL as implicit environment fallbacks. The wrapper overwrites those keys from CLI flags and refuses default dev values.

Do not point --scratch-db at odoo19, production, postgres, or any name lacking 'scratch'. A name containing scratch is not enough: --scratch-lifecycle CREATE_NEW_SCRATCH is required. That token is operator attestation only; the wrapper does not inspect PostgreSQL and does not verify that the database is new.

Do not use --http-port 8069 or --base-url http://localhost:3000. Playwright's config default is unsafe; the wrapper exists to prevent that default from being used. --base-url, --odoo-url, and --ws-url must be loopback (127.0.0.1, localhost, or ::1) with no unexpected path, query, or fragment.

Run Odoo checks from the upstream Odoo checkout via --python/--odoo-bin/--odoo-conf/--stock-addons. --stock-addons is the extra addons dir that contains project and hr (for example /Users/tariq/code/odoo/addons). Core base is <odoo-bin-dir>/odoo/addons/base, not stock/base. Pass the selected WebVue worktree addons as --addons-path <worktree>/odoo-addons.
A passing local isolated check is evidence for that scratch database and those ports only. It is not production, DNS, backup, or release proof.
